messages:
maya: Heads-up — a couple of customers pushed urgent asks around embeddings: variable dims per request, much larger batch uploads (they mentioned up to 500k tokens across the request). Can we scope this for Q2 GA?

liam: 500k tokens is ambiguous. Do they mean total input token count or number of vectors? For embeddings we should cap by vectors. Also need to pick which dims we support (256/768/1536/4096?).

jen: Ops reality: GPU memory limits mean we should cap by vector count. Current runtime safe limit ~100k vectors/GPU in ideal conditions. Proposal: GA supports up to 50k vectors/request, with a chunked-upload pattern for >50k and a server-side assemble step. That keeps latency predictable.

sam: Launch criteria checklist idea: backwards-compatible request shape, explicit `vector_dim` param, defaults to 1536 for the new default model, and include `model_id` & `dimension` in the response meta. Need clear migration notes for customers using fixed-dim assumptions.

liam: Model options I'm proposing for the surface: `redwood-embed-small` (768), `redwood-embed-standard` (1536), `redwood-embed-lite` (256). Also support quantized variants for cost-sensitive workloads. We should publish latency/cost matrix per vector count.

jen: API contract draft (quick):
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
Body: {"model":"redwood-embed-standard","inputs":["text1","text2",...],"vector_dim":1536,"precision":"fp16","batching":{"max_vectors":50000,"concurrency":4}}
Response: {"data":[{"id":"0","object":"embedding","embedding":[...]}],"meta":{"model":"redwood-embed-standard","dimension":1536,"request_vector_count":1200}}
```
Keep the top-level shape compatible with existing clients. Add `meta` for extra fields.

ops-bot: deploy-schedule: canary window requested 2025-10-03T16:00:00Z. Tag: embeddings-batching-v1.

maya: Customer asks also include deterministic full-precision outputs for some vector DBs. Recommend an opt-in `precision` param with values `fp32`|`fp16`|`int8` and `deterministic=true` to force reproducible quantization paths. We should warn about latency/cost tradeoffs.

jen: Open implementation items: multipart chunk upload API + assemble job, server-side validation of `max_vectors`, clear 413-style error for too-large requests, and retry semantics for chunked uploads. Action items: @sam to draft product spec, @liam to run perf matrix across dims/precision, @jen to prototype chunked upload in runtime.

sam: I'll draft the product spec today and include canary metrics/goals: p50 < 80ms/vector for 1k vectors (1536d fp16), and cost estimate per 1k vectors. +1 on GA cap 50k and chunked stream for larger workloads.

jen: Also consider response_format param: `dense` (flat float list) vs `sparse` (index/value pairs) — some customers want sparse vectors. Keep `embedding` as array for now, add `sparse` opt-in later.

liam: I'll add a table of recommended model->dimension choices and suggested default quantization profiles to the PR.

maya: Thanks — once the spec PR is up we'll loop in solutions and support for migration docs.

sam: Thanks team. I'll ping when the PR is ready. :thumbsup:
